name: worktree-switcher
description: Switch git worktrees from the status bar, or jump to a recent folder — always in the current window.

worktreeSwitcher.openInNewWindow.description: Open the selected worktree in a new window instead of reusing the current one.

worktreeSwitcher.statusBarAlignment.description: Which side of the status bar the worktree indicator sits on. Reload the window after changing.

worktreeSwitcher.statusBarPriority.description: Higher numbers move the indicator further left (for left alignment). Reload the window after changing.

worktreeSwitcher.recentStatusBarAlignmen.description: Which side of the status bar the recent-folders indicator sits on. Reload the window after changing.

worktreeSwitcher.recentStatusBarPriority.description: Higher numbers move the indicator further left (for left alignment). Default sits left of the worktree indicator. Reload the window after changing.

worktreeSwitcher.newWorktreeParentDir.description: Default parent directory for newly created worktrees. Empty means a sibling folder next to the main worktree.

worktreeSwitcher.statusBarFormat.markdownDescription: Worktree status bar label template. Supports codicons like `$(git-branch)` and the variables `${branch}`, `${folder}`, `${count}`, `${detached}`.

worktreeSwitcher.recentStatusBarFormat.markdownDescription: Recent-folders status bar label. Supports codicons like `$(history)`. This label is fixed text, not tied to the current folder.

worktreeSwitcher.showWorktreeStatus.description: Show uncommitted-change count and ahead/behind counts for each worktree in the picker.
